thread:
Noah: FYI Therion Labs wants to POC their 10B family (therion-10b-stance). Theyll bring weights + custom tokenizer. Needs: low-latency streaming, function-calls, 25k token KV, EU residency + customer KMS. Can we triage compatibility?
Sofia: Got it. Ask for presigned S3 bundle, tokenizer files, and a manifest with attention/norm details. Any hints on attention type?
Noah: They said "mixed rotary with sparse heads" in the spec.
Cal: Sparse attention + mixed rotary means we should verify if sparsity patterns map to our kernels. If not, we may need a compatibility shim or fall back to dense kernels (costly).
Maya: Security: they require customer-managed KMS, audit logs, and a signed attestation for EU residency. Also have an infosec questionnaire. I'll request point-of-contact.
Sofia: Plan: 1) get artifacts -> tokenizer sanity + tokenizer id map 2) run compat-scan (attention, norm, kv format) 3) recommend variants (fp16, q4_kv; test int8 if accuracy allows) 4) 48h dedicated canary for p50/p95/cost numbers.
Cal: For 25k tokens well validate KV sharding and memory. If sparsity requires special kernels, note potential perf/cost delta.
Noah: Customer asked about hot-swapping variants mid-POC for cost experiments. Quick take?
Cal: We support variant routing with warmup. Hot-swap is possible but expect a brief routing update and warmup; not atomic. Recommend scheduled switch after canary.
InfraBot: onboard created: ONB-241990 (steps: receive weights -> tokenizer check -> compat-scan -> build q4_kv -> 48h canary -> KMS/residency review).
Maya: Assignments: @Cal -> compat-scan + kernel analysis, @Sofia -> tokenizer check + perf baseline, @Maya -> infosec + legal loop, @Noah -> customer coord.
Sofia: While we wait for the weights, Ill run a synthetic against a comparable open 10B to produce an initial latency/cost estimate to share.
Noah: Can someone paste a short streaming sample curl for the client to smoke test dev integration?
Cal: Sample below (we'll update model_id after variant build):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\
  -d '{"model":"therion-10b-stance-q4_kv","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Analyze last commit failures"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_bug","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```
Maya: I'll request S3 presign and the infosec questionnaire now and loop in Legal for the EU residency clause. Will update ticket when artifacts land. :rocket:
